candidate.effect_number_definition: result-quantity occurrences only; model identifiers and design counts excluded

G3_non_substantive.basis: Same research identity and headline claim vector; v7's predicate set is a documented subset of v5/v6, its number set only shrinks, and no retained predicate is broadened or strengthened. Exact claim-set equality is not asserted because evidential credentials move to the main text.

deferred_risks: Omitted uncertainty and controls can look hidden until D1-D7 are visible in the manuscript.
Cloze detectability must not be read as an intact edit or non-erasure result.
Observed routes motivate a hypothesis; they do not identify natural mediation.
The ROME strict T-minus-N endpoint is not detectable and must remain visible in the main text.

G5_disposition_and_debts.reason: All rows have the required rationale/absence/destination triple, but no final W2 manuscript sections exist yet, so adoption remains blocked.

G6_mental_model.protocol: Balanced single-version, rubric-hidden retelling (four readers per version); separate scorers then applied an operational five-atom sensitivity rubric to retellings only. LLM compliance with the one-pass instruction is not directly enforceable. The prompt requested retelling and main implication separately, which can shift A5 into the latter field.
G6_mental_model.scoring_caveat: No exact atom aggregation was user-pre-specified. Atom 4 scores chain-local intervention/control-point content; observational-versus-interventional conflation is a separate calibration warning. Literal v7 atom-3 is scorer-sensitive (0/4 versus 1/4); scorer 2's lone hit used 'cloze retention' and simultaneously triggered an intactness-overread flag, yielding 0/4 under the conservative A3-without-I composite. Atom totals are sensitivity diagnostics, not a confirmatory statistic. Because the prompt separately requested the main implication, retelling-only A5 counts are not decision-bearing; all four v7 implication fields retain A5.
G6_mental_model.interpretation: V7 did not clearly exceed both baselines: balanced one-pass clarity ties v6, literal bounded-cloze retention is scorer-sensitive, and the conservative no-overread bounded-cloze composite is 0/4. This is failure to establish the required clear win, not evidence that v7 is intrinsically worse.
excluded_developmental_tests: A rubric-primed pilot was excluded because showing the atoms before retelling created a ceiling effect.

A five-reader comparative test favored an earlier 194-word v7 variant 5/5, but it is not adoption evidence for the final 197-word candidate and does not establish the final candidate's bounded-model retention.
